title: Is this the theatre? & is everyone dreaming about it right now?
content: I stumbled across this place last night after taking the interstate to get there (second picture is what mine looks like) from my high school bus pickup area. Me and some friends were walking thru this downtown strip area to shop and get food. I had to take a phone call so I slipped into the lobby of the cathedral looking building to sit on a bench away from the people and the noise. There were some men standing at the front doors about 20 feet from me who just stared at me like I didn’t belong there and I woke up. I’ve had plenty of “mall world” dreams since I was a kid but this is my first time seeing this place.
